arguments.command:
cd /app/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json
NF = 32
schema = []
for i in range(NF):
    schema.append({'name': 'field_name_number_%02d' % i, 'type': 'SIZE',
                   'min': -2147483648, 'max': 2147483647})
K = 8
atoms = [{'cmp': 'ge',
          'left': {'aggregate': 'mean', 'field': 'field_name_number_00', 'from': 0, 'to': K-1},
          'right': {'const': -2147483648, 'type': 'SIZE'}} for _ in range(20)]
def mktrace(tid, src, nrows, t0):
    rows = []
    for i in range(nrows):
        vals = [((tid * 37 + i * 13 + j * 7) % 4000000000) - 2000000000 for j in range(NF)]
        rows.append({'t': t0 + i * 3, 'values': vals})
    return {'id': tid, 'source': src, 'rows': rows}
train = [mktrace('trace%d' % i, 'src%d' % (i % 16), 136, i * 10000) for i in range(32)]
probes = [mktrace('probe', 'src0', 135, 0)]
queries = [mktrace('query%d' % i, 'src0', 135, 0) for i in range(8)]
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': schema, 'window': K, 'atoms': atoms,
       'policy': {'max_width': 4, 'min_support': 1, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': train, 'probes': probes, 'queries': queries}
data = json.dumps(req, separators=(',', ':'))
open('stress8.json', 'w').write(data)
rows = sum(len(t['rows']) for t in train + probes + queries)
print('bytes', len(data.encode()), 'rows', rows,
      'train_ctx', sum(len(t['rows'])-K+1 for t in train),
      'probe_ctx', 135-K+1, 'query_ctx', 8*(135-K+1))
PYEOF
cd /app/dev && (time /app/submission/run.sh < stress8.json > out8.json) 2>&1 | tail -3; python3 -c "
import json;r=json.load(open('/app/dev/out8.json'));print('classes',len(r['classes']),'members',sum(c['members'] for c in r['classes']));print('queries',len(r['queries']),r['queries'][0])"
